The two new `pullBlockIfNotFoundWithMessageSelector` methods pass `mq` directly to the impl, but the existing `pullBlockIfNotFound` method (visible in the context line just above) wraps it with `queueWithNamespace(mq)`. This inconsistency will cause the namespace to be lost in multi-namespace deployments. Both new methods should use `queueWithNamespace(mq)` to match the established pattern:
```java
this.defaultMQPullConsumerImpl.pullBlockIfNotFoundWithMessageSelector(queueWithNamespace(mq), selector, offset, maxNums, pullCallback);
```
